description: This Java source file defines the WorkFlowJobHelper class, which provides helper methods for configuring and logging workflow steps related to loan closing processes in Fineract system testing. It includes methods to set workflow jobs, update their configuration through API calls, and log the current configuration.

classes.name: WorkFlowJobHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing and configuring business workflow steps related to loan closure in Fineract system tests.

methods.name: setWorkflowJobs
methods.description: Initializes and updates the business step configuration for the 'LOAN_CLOSE_OF_BUSINESS' workflow by making an API call with a predefined list of business steps, then logs the current configuration.

methods.name: logChanges
methods.description: Retrieves the current business step configuration for the workflow and logs the sequence of steps after sorting by order.
